steps.what: Identify potential donors and build relationships with them
Stop the relationship when the donor declines the cause

tasks.design: The fundraiser identifies and builds relationships with potential donors. The conversation stays at full effort. Nobody is scored. {CRM} does not rank a donor and does not send an ask.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser met the donor and kept the relationship.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing who to know, and how, stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser stops when the donor does not want contact.
tasks.altitude: The relationship stays at full effort. Donors are not scored.

reach.task: Hear only from the fundraiser, not from a rule

evidence.claim: Identifying a donor and building the relationship stays a conversation.

assumptions: The brief is the donor, event, or cause the fundraiser already holds. A blank name is left blank.
No score is stored for a donor, a volunteer, or a member of staff. Upkeep is zero.
An ask for a gift is a different conversation from filing a record.
unknowns: Which of these conversations the fundraiser will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the fundraiser stop rather than ask?

already_counted.description: This conversation is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conversation adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every relationship is still built by the fundraiser. High: the same conversation remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Secure commitments of participation or donation from individuals
Secure the same commitments from corporate donors in person

tasks.design: The fundraiser secures commitments of participation or donation from individuals or corporate donors. The ask stays at full effort. A rule does not commit a donor. Nobody is scored. Bargaining stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser asked and the donor answered.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a donor commits stays with the fundraiser and the donor.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser does not record a commitment the donor did not give.
tasks.altitude: The ask and the commitment stay at full effort.

reach.task: Give or refuse the commitment in person

evidence.claim: Securing a commitment stays a conversation. A donor is not scored.

assumptions: The brief is the donor, event, or cause the fundraiser already holds. A blank name is left blank.
No score is stored for a donor, a volunteer, or a member of staff. Upkeep is zero.
An ask for a gift is a different conversation from filing a record.
unknowns: Which of these conversations the fundraiser will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the fundraiser stop rather than ask?

already_counted.description: This conversation is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conversation adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every commitment is still secured by the fundraiser. High: the same ask remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write and send letters of thanks

steps.what: Assemble stored gift facts for letters of thanks
Write letters of thanks to donors in the fundraiser's words
Review the thank-you letter before it is sent
Send the accepted letter of thanks

tasks.design: The fundraiser writes and sends letters of thanks to donors. {CRM} copies only a stored gift identifier, amount, and date. A blank gift stays blank and stops the draft. The fundraiser still writes the thanks, at full effort. {EMAIL} sends only the letter the fundraiser has accepted. The letter thanks that gift. It does not ask for another gift.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser wrote each thank-you from the gift note.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored gift facts can be copied into a draft line. The sentence stays the fundraiser's.
tasks.still_hard: The wording of the thanks stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser refuses a letter that fills a blank name or adds an ask.
tasks.altitude: The letter is sent only after the fundraiser accepts that version. It is not an ask.

reach.task: Receive only a thank-you the fundraiser accepted

evidence.claim: A stored gift can be copied into a thank-you draft. Writing the thanks stays manual, and the letter does not ask for another gift.

assumptions: The work starts with a recorded gift and ends when the accepted letter is sent, or the fundraiser stops.
A gift row has donor name, gift identifier, amount, and date, entered by the fundraiser. A blank name or amount is left blank and is not invented.
The send uses the letter accepted in the review. It does not solicit.
unknowns: Which gifts must have a thank-you before the week ends.
research_questions: How often did a blank gift stop the draft?

already_counted.description: Writing the thanks is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: Correct a gift fact before the letter is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: gift facts are often blank, so the fundraiser still writes the letter. High: gift facts are complete, the fundraiser rewrites and reviews, and only the accepted letter is sent. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Solicit cash donations from individual or business donors
Solicit sponsorships from government donors in person

tasks.design: The fundraiser solicits cash or in-kind donations or sponsorships from individual, business, or government donors. The ask stays at full effort. {EMAIL} does not send an ask. Nobody is scored. The applicable rules are those in force for this organisation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser asked the donor directly.
tasks.still_hard: What to ask, and of whom, stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser stops when the donor should not be asked.
tasks.altitude: The solicitation stays at full effort. Donors are not scored.

reach.task: Hear the ask from the fundraiser
reach.learn: Which asks the fundraiser refused to make.

evidence.claim: Soliciting a donation or a sponsorship stays a conversation.

assumptions: The brief is the donor, event, or cause the fundraiser already holds. A blank name is left blank.
No score is stored for a donor, a volunteer, or a member of staff. Upkeep is zero.
An ask for a gift is a different conversation from filing a record.
Government donors are contacted under the rules in force. No foreign filing process is invented.
unknowns: Which of these conversations the fundraiser will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the fundraiser stop rather than ask?

already_counted.description: This conversation is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conversation adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every ask is still made by the fundraiser. High: the same solicitation remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The fundraiser still asks, bargains, and chooses the donor. A thank-you, a grant file, or a report is sent or stored only after the fundraiser accepts that version.
reach: A donor receives only a thank-you the fundraiser has accepted.
A funding organisation receives only materials the fundraiser has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a gift, amount, or name is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep the ask, the commitment, and the strategy in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every thank-you traces to a stored gift, and the fundraiser still writes the sentence.
